# Scripted ordinary-decoration base normalization

These 48 public cases use the unchanged MathJax 3.2.2 oracle embedded in D2 v0.8.1 (source commit `ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee`). `generate-scripted-decoration.cjs` rehashes all three assets before rendering. The primary fixture retains every original reference, including errors, kind/text/explicit attributes/own properties and ordered children; comparison does not claim inherited/default/flag equality for public compiler trees.

The accepted baseline is `c57a3ee4c3db310de4d33a5b0ab9f4c1d9da1dde`. The production change follows `ParseUtil.underOver` lines 375–386 after the existing direct `checkMovableLimits`: an embellished munder, mover or munderover gets explicit core lspace/rspace zero, then a new row containing a zero-child mo with rspace zero and the identical incoming base. Side-script families and grouped top-level bases remain excluded. The existing node-specific `limitsCore` supplies the primary coreMO policy. Braces, bar's Accent dispatch, permission/subsupOK, attachment, renderer and core traversal helpers remain unchanged.

The original D073 change made 22 complete SVGs raw-primary exact. The subsequent D071 permission correction removes the four remaining false-error qualifications, so all 48 complete SVGs are now raw primary. The primary fixture is unchanged. There are still two raw explicit projections and zero raw own-property projections. Remaining differences are finite listed maps observed unchanged in accepted efd6d63071862218af992a6074e3c8680b634ab4, either the same formula or its exact decoration prefix where the old formula failed. The witness records preserve exact node shapes/paths and complete maps. No broad omission, wrapper stripping or geometry tolerance is used.

The inherited D072 fixture now has all 60 raw-primary SVGs after its separate 22 permission upgrades. D072/D073 normalization logic remains unchanged by D071.

The 24 registered private controls invoke the actual unmodified primary ParseUtil.underOver with registered factory nodes, preserving complete normalized maps, dynamic embellishment/spacelike state, selected core identity and every original node's parent/child identities. They cover all eligible and excluded families, nonembellished bases, nonzero row core, selected maction core, transparent wrappers, zero-child input, own movablelimits, and attached-parent/sibling cases. The Go input builder reproduces registered TeXAtom's own ORD property. The fixture also retains primary outer permission. D071 now asserts that permission on actual ordinary constructor returns; this normalization-only test continues to compare the unchanged normalized base. Twelve real constructor controls exercise all six ordinary commands in both modes. Parser-phase observations verify movable under/over construction precedes final filtering; no side-family lift is added.

Mutation controls separately reject a text-bearing empty token, cloned base, generic core-to-text descent and widened side-family predicate. Accepted production, with unchanged new public tests, must fail exactly the 22 new fixes plus the two inherited upgrades; compiler failures are not regression evidence.
